tei:div.tei:p: "$ (275)༄༅// rdzogs chen sems sde'i khrid yig bzhugs so/// /

nyang lugs so// (276)༄༅// na mo gu ru bhya: khyab bdag thog ma'i ston pa kun tu bzang*// gdul bya'i don du tha mal tshul bzung nas// skal ldan byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa// bla chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud// rang sems gdod nas dag pa'i sangs rgyas de// glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri mas 'khor bar 'khyams// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i mtsho las thar slad du// gsang chen khrid kyi rim pa 'dir brjod bya/ de la 'o skol rnams kyi sems zhes bya ba'i rig rig tur tur po 'di/ kun tu bzang po dang dus mnyam du dang po nyid du byung ba yin kyang*/ kun tu bzang pos rang du mkhyen pas grol/ rang re sems can rnams kyis ngo ma shes pas 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams/ rigs drug gi lus grangs las 'das pa blangs/ byas pa thams cad don med du song*/ da res mi lus brgya la lan gcig thob pa'i dus 'dir 'khor ba ngan song du mi skye ba'i thabs shig ma 'grub na/ shi nas gar skye nges pa med cing*/ 'gro ba rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal las ma 'das te/ (277)dmyal ba la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro la bkol spyod dang klan zhing rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal/ mi la skye rga na 'chi dang yod po 'tsho skyong*/ med po brel phongs/ dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad kyi dogs pa/ gnyen byams pa dang bral gyi dogs pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das shing*/ lha ma yin la'ang 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal/ lha la 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal te rgyas par bla mas zhib tu 'chad/ mdo las kyang*// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// mi lus 'di yang thob pas mi chog ste/ nam 'chi cha med pas/ da lta nyid du chos gsha' ma gcig byed dgos pa de yang*/ 'chi khar mi 'gyod pa rang gis rang la mi khrel ba rje btsun mi la lta bu gcig dgos te// nga mi la ras pa'i chos lugs la// rang gis rang la ma khrel ba// zhes pa dang*/

rgyal ba yang dgon pas// mi snying can kun rang la phyi thag srings// rang mi bslu na snying nas chos gcig gyis// zhes gsungs (278)pas/ nam 'chi cha med dran pas dgra 'dul gnyen skyong la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi bya ba la zhen pa log pa/ lto gos gtam gsum 'jig rten chos brgyad sogs la ma chags pa rtse gcig tu chos la blo sgril ba gcig dgos te/ 'chi ba snying zug gi dben gnas su// zhen pa gting log gi sgrub pa po// tshe 'di blos btang gi sku mtshams bcad// sems chos brgyad kyi mi dang mjal 'phrad med// ces rgyal ba yang dgon pa lta bu zhig byed dgos/ de byed pa la khrid bsgom byed dgos/ khrid de yang tshig shes pa tshig khrid/ don shes pa don khrid/ nyams skyes pa nyams myong skyes pa yon tan gyi khrid/ mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i khrid dang bzhi yin la/ mthar phyin pa 'bras bu ni sangs rgyas yin pas/ de ma thob kyi bar du bsgom dgos/ de sgom par byed pa la don gsum ste/ gzhi sems bskyed kyis bzung nas skyabs 'gro la 'bad dgos te/ skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs nas/ rang dang sems can thams cad kyis skyabs 'gro byed par bsam nas skyabs 'gro stong dang khri la sogs pa byas/ mthar dbang bzhi blangs te de rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ de'i ngang la rnam rtog gang shar de spang yang ma spang*/ rjes su yang mi 'phro/ kho rang gi thog tu slod la bzhag pas yal 'gro zhing*/ yang*/ rnam rtog gcig skye/ de la yang gong ltar bya/ mdor na rnam rtog gang skyes kyang de kha'i thog tu bzhag /gzhan nas gzhug rgyu rang med/ de rang ngo shes tsam gyi ngang la slod de 'jog go /skyabs 'gro dang slod nas 'jog pa 'di gnyis res mos su byas la zhag gsum mam lnga'am/ bdun la sogs pa gnad dang bstun par bya'o// de nas sdig sgrib 'dag par byed pa yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas sgom gyi khrid ni/

rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bor bsgom pa'i zhabs kyi mthe bong nas bab pa'i bdud rtsis rang gi sdig sgrib thams cad ded nas sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu (279)song*/ lus bdud rtsi dkar pos gang*/ yi ge brgya pa brgya rtsa sogs song nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' la dbang bzhi blangs te/ 'od du zhu rang la bstims nas/ gong ltar ngal gso zhing rnam rtog la blta lugs dang zhag grangs gong dang 'dra/ gsum pa tshogs bsags maṇḍal gyi khrid ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam dkon mchog rnams skyabs 'gro'i skabs ltar gsal btab la maṇḍal tshom bu so bdun ma dang*/ sa gzhi spos byugs sogs dang*/ sman gyi maṇḍal// 'bru'i maṇḍal/ rin po che'i maṇḍal la sogs pa phyi kun rdzob rdzas kyi maṇḍal/ nang don dam rdo rje lus kyi maṇḍal/ gsang ba zung 'jug sems kyi maṇḍal/ yang gsang sku gsum gyi maṇḍal la sogs pa gang shes khams kyis lcogs tshad phul ba// thun mtshams su dbang bzhi blangs nas ngal gso zhing rnam rtog la blta ba gong ltar bya/ zhag grangs kyang 'dra'o// bzhi pa byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid ni/ rang yi dam gang yin gyi spyi bor seng khri dang pad zla'i steng du/ ngo bo chos 'di ston pa'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa o rgyan yab yum mam/ kun tu bzang po la sogs pa rang gang mos shig bsgoms la de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang gi sngar 'das pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*/ da lta chos 'brel zhus shing mos gus tshugs pa rnams dang*/ ma 'ongs pa na rang nyid sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du 'byon rgyu'i bla ma thams cad spyan drangs nas/ de la bstims pas bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsam/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs nas/ de la bstims pas yi dam kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsams/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad spyan drangs/

de la bstims pas bla ma kun 'dus yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher bsam (280)nas mos gus mchi ma 'khrugs pa ma byung bar du byas la bla ma de rang gi sku bstod dam/ med na bla ma sku gsum ma lta bu'i sham bur/ ka dag gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// gang shar rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs// rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin skye bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par byin gyi rlobs/ zhes ma yengs pa'i ngang nas brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du gsol ba btab/ mthar bla ma las dbang bzhi blang*/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas bstims te gong ltar mnyam par gzhag /mthar dge ba bsngo'o// bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di ni sngon 'gro'i dus su zhag grangs gong ltar bya/ dngos gzhi nas thun gyi mgo dar khrid thon nas kyang dus rnams kun tu ma chags pa grangs su bcad nas byed pa gal che ste/ sgom rgyud la ma skyes pa'i mi des kyang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhag re la tshar lnga ma chags par byas na/ 'pho ba 'debs mi dgos te rang shugs la thebs yong*/ zhes rgyal ba rgod tshang pas gsungs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor mos gus dang 'brel bar ma byas na bsgom skye ba phul/ cung zad skyes kyang gegs sdang*/ rtogs pa rgyud la skye mi btub pas bcos min gyi mos gus byung na rab/ med na nga'i bla ma 'di sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam la ngag tu yang brjod/ lus khrims kyis bsgrim/ thal mo sbyar la/ gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pas/ ji zhig nas bcos min gyi dad pa rang shugs la skye'o// de'ang mos gus rab la byin rlabs rab/ mos gus 'bring la byin rlabs 'bring*/ mos gus tha mas byin rlabs tha ma/ mos gus gtan nas med na byin rlabs kyang mi 'byung bas mos gus kho na gal che ste/ pha dam pa byin rlabs shig zhu dang zhus pas/

bu lhod po mos gus gcig zhu dang gsungs skad/ de ltar gnas skabs thams cad du byas pa'i yon tan gyis rtogs pa (281)khyad par can tshig gis brjod du mi nus pa rang gi nang nas skye ste/ bla ma zhang rin po ches/ gnas pa bskyang ba/ nyams myong bskyang ba/ ting nge 'dzin bskyang ba la sogs pa mang bar gda' ste/ mos gus kyi stobs las bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis nang nas skye ba 'di dkon par gda'/ zhes dang*/ o rgyan rin po ches/ spyi bo'i rgyan du nga nyid rgyun du bsgom// bslas na pad 'byung zhan no rje 'bangs rnams// zhes gsungs pas rang gis sgom nus na bla mas mi bslu nges te// rgan mo'i mos gus kyis khyi so las 'od byung ba bzhin no// de ltar sngon 'gro nan tan gal che ste/ rdzogs pa chen po'i don rgyud la skye ba sngon 'gro la rag las pa yin no// rje 'bri gung bas chos gzhan dngos gzhi zab par byed de/ nged 'dir sngon 'gro zab par byed// ces gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yang de lta yin par gda' 'o// rang rgyud la nang nas ma skyes na/ bla mas bstan pa'i chos rnams tshig gi lta sgom yin pas don spyi tsam las ma 'das/ nang nas rang rgyud la skye ba ni/ sgom thog nas lta ba 'tshol ba zhes bya ste/ rdzogs chen pa'i khyad chos yin// gsang sngags kyi lta ba bde stong yin zhes jo bo rjes gsungs pa de yang 'di yin/ phyag chen man chad lta thog nas sgom 'chol ba yin/ de bas na bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brtson par shin tu gal che/ spyir deng sang snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus 'dir/ gang zag bcu tshun chad la chos ston cing*/ don byed pa'i bla ma de sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa yin/ zhes o rgyan chen pos gsung gu ru rnon rtse'i gter lung du 'dug go /sgom gyi skal ba med pa gcig gis kyang*/ mos gus kyis gsol ba 'debs nus na/ skye ba dang tshe rabs su ngan song gsum du mi 'khyams te/

ji skad du/ gdams pa rgya mtsho khong du ma chud kyang*// spyi bor bla ma bsgom zhing dad pa yis// mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs shing gsol 'debs pa// ngan (282)'gro'i skye sgo gcod pa'i sgom chen yin// zhes sa skya paṇa chen gsungs/ bla ma ni mi rang du 'dug /mi yis mi la gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs e yong ngam snyam pa mi 'tshal te/ sngags gsar ma'i gzhung las kyang*/ bla ma las ni yon tan dang*/ mtho ris bde ba thams cad thob// bla mas dman pa'i skye bo las// dngos grub mchog ni 'byung ba ni// zhes pas/ bla ma mi tha mal par 'dug kyang*/ gsol ba btab na mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas myur tu thob par gsungs la/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhes gsang sngags bla med las gzhan du ma grags so// da ni dngos gzhi la gang zag gi rigs brtags dgos te/ dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum las/ rab kyi rab/ rab kyi 'bring*/ rab kyi tha ma/ de bzhin du 'bring la gsum/ tha ma la yang gsum ste dgu'o// de dag la yang gcig car ba ni/ sgom bstan pa tsam gyis rtogs grol dus mnyam pa yin te/ rgya gar du sa ra ha dang*/ bod du gling ras las ma byung zhes grags/ zhig po bdud rtsis/ shab stod bya ru gsum mdo nas// klung shod 'bri gung yan chad du gzigs kyang ma rnyed/ yod ni los yod zhes gsungs/ de 'dra'i rigs la bsgom btab ma thag rgyud la skye/ gegs sel bogs 'don kyang mi dgos pa yin par gda'/ thod rgal ba ni res sgom rang shugs la yong res mi yong*/ ya 'ud can yin pas 'di las rim skyes pa dga' zhes rgyal ba yang dgon pas gsungs/ 'on kyang bar du 'di sa chod che bar bshad/ rim skyes pa ni nas kyi myu gu ltar rim par skye ba yin/ de gsum dang gang zag rigs dgu yang yin par ngo shes na so so'i rigs dang go lugs bstan nas bshad/ 'on te ngo shes par dka' bas sngon 'gro'i skabs kyi mnyam gzhag gi sems kyi gnas pa che na zhi gnas yin pas de thog tu lhag mthong bstan/

gnas pa chung zhing 'phro rgod che na/ de yang bsgom skyes pa (283)yin te/ 'phro rgod mang po de de snga nas yod kyang*/ mnyam par ma bzhag pas ma tshor ba yin/ de mnyam par gzhag pas tshor ba yin/ nyams dang po ri gzar gyi chu bab de yin/ de gnas pa'i dus dang 'gyu ba'i dus gnyis kyi sems kyi ngo bo gcig las 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos dang byas la zhag gsum la sogs par blta ru bcug /de gnyis mi gcig par 'dug zer na/ yang bskyar la zhib tu bltar bcug /gcig par 'dug zer na byung gnas 'gro gsum rtsad gcod du bcug nas ngo sprad de rgyun bskyang bar bya'o// gal te de ltar ma byung ba'am gang zag blo ris gang yin yang rung ste/ so so'i blo tshod dang bstun nas bla ma nyams myong can gyis khrod shes par bya ba ni kun tu gces so// da ni dbang po rab la khrid tshul mdo tsam smos na khyod rang sngon 'gro'i mnyam gzhag ltar du rnam rtog gang shar de la rtse gcig tu ma yengs pa rang gyis gi sa la sgoms/ gal te yengs 'gro yi 'dug na rnam rtog thol te skyes pa dang rbad de chod la ma yengs par gyis la rnam rtog gang yang skye ru ma bcug par rig pa sgrims/ sems kyi mkhar sgo 'dir gnyen po'i mdud thud gcig bzung nas kho sgrim na nga sgrim/ kho lhod na nga lhod bya ba de yin/ 'on kyang sngar rnam rtog mang drags pa'i skyon byung 'dug pas/ rnam rtog dgag gang thub gyis/ 'gyu ba'i 'gro 'ong rbad kyis chod// glang chen lob nas sems tshags tshud pa ltar// 'gro 'ong bcas na ngang gis dal ba ste// 'di ltar rtogs su nga la chos ci dgos/ zhes pa dang*/ tha mal rnam rtog ma rtogs pa// de ltar 'di ni mngon dgag ste// zhes gsungs pas rnam rtog dgag gang thub gyis/ rnam rtog dgag ma thub na sgom mi yong ba 'dug go byas la sdig ri bskur/ zhag gsum la sogs pa sha thang chad chad nan tan byed du bcug pas rnam rtog dgag ma thub pa dang*/

da 'o na rnam rtog gang skyes de 'phro bas mi (284)chog 'phro ba de mu la mu mthud kyis 'phro ba rgya che ru rang chug la/ 'phro gang thub ma gtogs rnam rtog med pa skad cig tsam yang ma byed par 'phro ru rang chug /sems la ngal ba skad cig kyang ma sdod par blos 'chos kyin 'phro ru chug byas la sngar ltar zhag gsum bya/ des 'phro ba 'phro ru ma btub par gang shar du rtog med du gnas pa gcig 'ongs kyang*/ 'di yin ngos bzung rgyu med pa gcig 'ong*/ da de gnyis gcig gam mi gcig bsgrim ste ltos la shog byas la/ gcig mi gcig gang du yang 'dzin ngo ma shes pa'i had had po ti chal ba zhig lhag 'ong*/ de ltar byung ba dang de nas sems 'tshol bya ste/ 'das rjes las/ dang po sems kyi byung sa btsal// zhes sogs gsungs pas/ khyod rang gi sems 'di dang po kun tu bzang po dang dus mnyam pa nas bzung da lta phan chad du 'khor ba nas 'khor bar 'khyams/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong mkhan mi byed dgu byed mi dran dgu dran 'di la dang po byung sa gcig yod nges pa'i ga 'dra zhig nas byung tshol cig /kun tu bzang po dang mnyam du byung na/ byung ba'i byung lugs ga 'dra zhig 'dug /yang de'i sngon du e byung yang tshol phyi nas byung ngam nang nas byung*/ steng 'og bar gsum phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi gang nas byung tshol la shog byas la nan tan byed du 'jug /de ltar tshol du phyin pa dang*/ 'di yin gang du yang brjod mi shes pa'i hon ne ba gcig 'dug zer na des chog /gzhan zer na phug ma chod pas yang yang bskyar nas don la phebs pa dang*/ da sems 'di ga na gnas/ lus kyi nang na gnas sam phyi dang bar ga na gnas 'dug /de bzhin steng 'og phyogs mtshams ga na gnas ltos la shog byas la nan tan byed du bcug /nang na 'dug zer na nang gi ga na 'dug blta/ snying gi nang na 'dug zer na/ 'o na snying la bug pa med pas/

shi nas snying ma zhig bar du de ka ru yod dgos te/ ro la sems med pas de 'dra (285)ma yin da dung ltos shig /phyi na 'dug zer na/ phyi'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams ga na 'dug /dbyibs dang kha dog ci 'dra gcig 'dug bltar bcug /'di 'dra zhig 'dug zer na/ mi 'dug tshul zhib tu bshad/ lar nas la mi 'dug zer na/ 'o na mi 'dug zer mkhan cig 'dug pa tshol shog byas pas/ 'di 'dra zhig 'dug zer na de ltar ma yin pa'i tshul zhib tu bshad/ zer rgyu ci 'dug kyang de'i ngo bo rtsad bcad la ngos bzung med pa'i sangs sangs yal yal lar brjod mi shes pa gcig 'dug zer na des chog /da khyod rang gi sems de sna tshogs su 'char zhing 'gyu ba gcig 'dug pa'i/ mtha' phug ga ru 'gro yi 'dug /'gro na 'gro mkhan e 'dug /'gro sa de yang ga 'dra zhig 'dug zhib tu rtog la shog byas la btang*/ 'gro sa 'dug zer na/ 'dug pa'i 'dug lugs rtsad bcad du bcug /mi 'dug zer na dge ba byas pas mtho ris su 'gro/ sdig pa byas pas ngan song du 'gro/ 'gro mkhan ni sems yin pas 'gro ba'i 'gro lugs ga 'dra zhig 'dug 'gro mkhan rang ga 'dra zhig 'dug tshol la shog bya'o// de ltar 'gro sa dang 'gro mkhan yod thang ba la blta ru phyin nas yal 'gro ba'i gang yang med pa zhig 'dug zer na ngo sprad pa ni/ 'o de ltar yin te khyod kyi sems la byung sa ma rnyed pa de/ skye ba med pa chos kyi sku bya ba yin/ sems la ngo bo dang ngos bzung gang yang med pas stong pa yin/ de la byung sa ga la 'ong*/ de skye ba med pa chos kyi sku bya ba yin/ de nas sems kyi gnas sa ma rnyed pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo las/ rab 'byor sems ni phyi na yang mi gnas/ nang na yang mi gnas/ gang du'ang gnas pa ma yin no zhes gsungs pa de yin te/ sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gzhi yin/ tha ma 'gro sa ma rnyed pa ni/ dang po 'ongs sa med/

bar du gnas sa med pa (286)la/ tha ma 'gro ba ga la yod/ de ni sprul pa'i sku'i gzhi ru brjod pa tsam yin/ de ltar sems dngos po dang mtshan ma gang du yang ma grub pas/ ye gdod ma nas stong zhing bdag med pa yin no// 'das rjes las/ dang po sems kyi byung sa btsal// ma rnyed chos kyi sku dang 'phrad// bar du sems kyi gnas sa btsal// ma rnyed longs spyod sku dang 'phrad// tha ma sems kyi 'gro sa btsal// ma rnyed sprul pa'i sku dang 'phrad// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de ltar sems de glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs pa ma gtogs/ ye gdod ma nas sangs rgyas pa yin te/ rdzogs chen las/ ye sangs rgyas shig yin pa la// yang sangs rgyas shig 'dod pa 'khrul// ces gsungs so// de ltar glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i sems de ngo bo stong pa yin kyang*// rang bzhin gsal ba dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang ldan pas chos sku de yang stong pa cang med ri bong gi rwa lta bu'am/ mu stegs chad lta ba lta bu ma yin pas/ rdzogs chen las/ chos sku ci yi ngo bor ma grub pa/ sems can shes rab chung bas med par go /zhes pas/ dngos po gdos bcas su ma grub kyang*/ stong pa'i gdangs ma 'gags pa las/ ngo bo sku ru bzhugs/ rang bzhin 'od du bzhugs/ thugs rje zer gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'o// de'i rtsal las longs spyod rdzogs skur shar te/ sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa'i don mdzad/ sprul pa'i skus sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa'o// de ltar de ring nas sems sangs rgyas su ngo sprad pa yin kyang*/ mthar phyin nas brtan pa thob pa lam shi bar bskyang dgos te/ ji ltar bskyang na/ gong du brdar sha bcad pa bzhin/ sems kho rang gnas rung sems yin/ 'gyu rung sems yin/ sems stong par thag chod phyin chad/ gnas 'gyu gnyis la khyed par ci yang ma byung bas/ rnam rtog gang shar gang byung (287)gang snang thams cad ye shes kyi rol pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa zab mo stong pa nyid yin/

de la bcos bslad gang yang ma byed par de ka'i ngang la zhog /gnas skabs su rnam rtog rang ga mar 'dug na'ang*/ ngam ngam shugs kyis grol yod pas ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig yin/ chos sku yin/ rang byung ye shes yin/ phyag rgya chen po yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ dpe thag pa mes tshig pa dang 'dra/ des 'ching mi nus/ de bzhin du kho rang gi ngo bo stong stong pa yin// rnam rtog ltar snang ba de bzhin ni/ stong pa'i gdangs shar ba yin/ rnam rtog dang stong pa la khyad mi 'dug pa 'di la o rgyan chen pos/ rnam rtog ngo bo stong pa'i chos skur go /zhes gsungs pa de yin/ bsgom na blo yin pas bsgom rgyu ci yang med/ rnam rtog rang ga mar zhog /de la bcos bslad byas na rnam rtog rang rgyud pa 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud yin pas bcas bcos gang yang mi byed/ rang thog tu 'jog pa de las yengs na 'khrul pa dngos yin pas ma yengs pa dgos te de gcig pos chog /sngon rje zur chung ba la rma thog byang 'bar gyis rtsod pa na/ khyod rdzogs chen pa bya ba sgom rang byed kyi yod pa 'dra byas pas/ 'ong dmigs pa gang la gtad 'dug gsungs/ 'o na mi sgom mam byas pas// 'o nga gang la yengs 'dug gsungs// de lta bu gcig dgos pa lags// rdzogs chen gu ru bzhi pa las// sgom ma myong dang 'bral ma myong*// mi sgom don dang mi 'bral ba// zhes pa gang shar sgom yin pas na/ blo bcos pa'i bsgom rgyu med pas sgom ma myong*/ yengs na don med 'chal pa yin pas rang thog tu 'jog pa de dang 'bral ma myong*/ mi sgom pa'i don de lta bu dang rgyun du mi 'bral ba gyis zhes pa'i don te/ 'di la dbang po'i khyad par gyis zhag bdun cu bzhi dang zla ba gcig nas ched 'dzin gyis ma yengs pa de mi (288)dgos par gang shar rtsol med du 'jog thub pa zhig yong*/ 'di la rdzogs chen pa ye grol klong yangs kyi dgongs pa zer/

phyag rgya chen po rang gsal gyi dran pa zer bar gda'/ de'i rgyun bar ma chad par bskyangs pas/ rnam pa tha mal gyi shes pa 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog rang ga ma dang khyad par spu tsam yang med la/ ngo bo der 'dzin med pa'i sa le trig ge ba mnyam gzhag yul phud/ rjes thob rkang stong*/ bag chags g.ya' dag pa'i shes pa ngos bzung dang bral kyang rnam rtog ltar snang ba zhig yod/ de chos sku dngos yin/ rdzogs chen sems phyogs pas/ rnam rtog mi mnga' ci yang sa ler mkhyen/ bya ba'ang 'di la zer te/ deng sang ni sgom chen pa tsho 'di'i zur thos na snying 'gas la thug pa tsam byed kyin gda' ste/ grub chen mi tra dzo kis/ cir snang rang sor bzhag na bya bral lhun gyis grub// ces gsungs pa lags/ de ltar 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rang gis rang grol bas na/ phyi gzung ba'i yul gzugs sgra la sogs pa dag kyang rang grol la shugs kyis 'gro ste mig gi yul du gzugs legs nyes/ rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan mi snyan/ sna la dri zhim mi zhim/ lce la ro zhim mngar/ lus la reg bya 'jam rtsub/ sems bde sdug /chags sdang*/ dgra gnyen/ sa chu me rlung la sogs pa mdor na gang shar gang snang de kha la bzo bcos med par 'jog pa yin te/ rdzogs chen las/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes gsal ba la// yid kyi zhen rtog ma zhugs na// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa de ga rang*// zhes dang*/ zhi byed pas/ don go rtog pa'i mtshang rig na// rnam rtog shar che gnas pa che// nyon mongs rags che ye shes gsal/ ces bzhed do// de bas na rdzogs chen gyi dgongs pa ni/ gang shar de spong yang mi spong*/ de'i rjes su yang mi 'bring*/ de ga la bcas bcos mi byed par 'jog pa 'di ka yin no// de yin (289)pas de la spang bya med/ gnyen po med/ dgag sgrub blang dor la sogs pa blos byas kyi chos gang yang med pas na/ blo 'das chos sku de bzhin nyid ces pa'ang de yin// de dag ni dbang po rab kyi dbang du byas pa yin pas/

rab kyi rab 'bring tha gsum la so so'i blo nus dang sbyar te khrid par bya'o// da ni dbang po 'bring gsum zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sgo nas khrid par bya ste/ de yang kun bzang dgongs 'dus las// zhir ma gnas na lhag mi mthong*// lhag ger ma mthong zhi mi gnas// zhes gsungs pas/ de gnyis dus mnyam du 'ong ba zhig byed dgos la/ de'i dpe yang*// bya med sgo nga gang las byung*// sgong med bya de gang las byung*// bya dang sgo nga gang snga'o// zhes pas/ snga phyi med pas dus mnyam pa dgos pa byung*/ de la rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i mgur las/ chos rdzogs chen zer ba'i sgra bo che// sprang go ba'i len phyogs kyang de la bgyis// gcig char gyi rtogs pa'ang de las 'khrungs// zhes khong gi rtogs pa rdzogs chen las 'khrungs par bzhed la/ rje des ji ltar bsgom pa ni/ mgur las// ye ba sgom la blo yis ma bsgom mdzod// rang bab la bzo yis ma bcos mdzod// blo rtog pa la skyon du mi blta zhing*// mi rtog pa ched du ma bsgom par// sems rang lugs su zhog la rgyang so tshugs// sgom zhi gnas kyi mthil du phebs 'di la dran bsleb na zhi lhag zung 'brel yin/ pa zhig 'ong gi /zhes pa go sla la/ de ka ltar goms 'dris byed du bcug la gnyug bsrings pas ji zhig na 'gyu ba je nyung la song*/ sems kyi gnas pa je brtan pa 'gro/ zhi gnas 'thug po 'dod na de ka'i rgyun bskyangs nas bsgoms pas/ rnam rtog phra rags 'gag te ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo gang du yang ma grub pa'i stong pa/ gsal la rtog pa med par lus sems yod du mi tshor la/ ting nge 'dzin de dang 'bral mi (290)phod pa'i bde nyams can cig 'char/ mu mthud nas bsgom pas spyan lnga dang*/ mngon par shes pa'i yon tan kyang 'byung ste bsam gtan zer ba yin/ bsgom na 'phar bas bsam gtan bzhi dang skye mched mu bzhi'i sems gnas rtse gcig pa ste/

mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug par dgu zer/ dgu po 'di mu stegs la'ang yod pas phyi nang thun mong gi lam yin kyang rnam rtog 'phro drags nas kha bri ma thub pa de la zhi gnas dgos pa byung bas na zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ nyon mongs rnam par spong ba shes byas nas/ thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya zhes sogs gsungs pa yin/ lhag mthong med na 'dis sa lam mi bgrod pas sems kyi gnas pa cha tsam rnyed dam rnam rtog 'di ma 'phros na dga' ba snyam pa'i dus der/ rnam rtog de rang ngo shes tsam byas la kho rang gi ngo bo la bltas pas yal te/ gnas pa dang gcig tu song ba ni zhi lhag zung 'brel bya ba yin/ dwags po bka' brgyud pa gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'gyel ba zer/ ngo bo blos byas pa'i sgom yin/ 'di la ngo shes kyi dran pa dang ma bral ba dgos pas bka' brgyud pa stong nyid gzung dran zer/ 'di ka rgyun bskyangs nas bsgoms pas/ gzung dran de rang gsal gyi dran pa ru 'gro/ ma yengs pa rang byas na 'di yang kha gze mo zhig yin te/ zla ba gcig tsam nas nyin snang 'dre thub/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pas/ snang ba thams cad stong par yang mi bsgom/ mi stong par yang mi bsgom/ gang shar de la dran pas gzung na zla ba gcig rang gis chog ste/ spros bral dang po rang gnas 'ong*// zhes gsungs/ hril bsgril na/ sngar gyi zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin de rang ngo shes pas zhi lhag zung 'brel lam/ phyag rgya chen po'am/ rdzogs pa chen po zhes zer te/ sngar gyi mgung de'i 'phro las/ blo rtog pa 'gyu ba gnas lugs kyi sgo// rang ngo (291)shes pa nyams len gyi gnad/ zhes gsungs pa la 'du'o/ 'di la 'bring gi 'bring*/ tha ma gnyis kyis rnam rtog rang ga ma de sgom yin par yid la ma 'byed na/ rnam rtog gang shar de la bltas pas/ gang shar thams cad stong par yal/ yal ba de'i ngang nas gcig steng la gcig 'char/ de la yang bltas pas sngar ltar yal/

de ka rgyun skyong ba yin te/ mgur las/ sems ngos bzung med pa stong pa'i dbyings// sna tshogs su 'char ba rig pa'i sgo/ blo bral gyi gsal stong rjen pa 'di la// ngang la bzhag gi na dbyings la ltos dang*// sgom lhag mthong gi mthil du phebs pa zhig 'ong gi /zhes gsungs pa bzhin byed du 'jug /'di na mi tra dzo ka'i gsung gis/ gang shar ngo yis bzung na rig pa rang sar grol/ zhes pas/ las sla la 'chun che ba zhig yin no// rab 'bring gsum ga'i thun mong du bsgom lugs ni/ mgur las/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa so ma shor// ma bsgom pa'i gnas lugs bzo ma byas// bsam med kyi rig pa smra ma 'dod// rtag chad kyis ma bslad kha yan du skyong dang*// bsgom zhi lhag zung du chug pa zhig 'ong gi zhes gsungs pa go sla yang*/ dran pa ma yengs pas gang shar la bzo bcos mi byed// shar yang yod par mi blta// yal kyang med par mi 'dzin/ rnam rtog gi sna mi bskyil bar 'phro ru bcug nas ngo shes tsam byed pa'o// rdzogs chen sems sde las// gdod nas dag pa dbyings kyi ngang nyid nas// rig pa thol skyes skad cig dran pa de// rgya mtsho'i gting nas nor bu rnyed pa 'dra// sus kyang ma bcos ma byas chos kyi sku// zhes gsungs pa ltar ngo sprad do// da ni dbang po tha ma gsum la phal cher lhag mthong la yid mi ches/ zhi gnas gsha' ma yang skyer mi btub ste/ res byed/ res (292)rgod nas bsgom mi 'char bas/ sngon 'gro phyin rdzogs pa dang*/ stan bde ba la rab rdo rje skyil krung*/ de min skyil krung phal pa bca'/ sgal tshig bsrang la lag pa mnyam gzhag bya/ dpung pa yid tsam phyir dgye/ mgrin pa yid tsam bkug lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mig gnyis sna rtse la blta ba ste rnam snang chos bdun bya/ rlung ro sna bug g.yas g.yon gnyis nas gsum gsum dang*/ gnyis ka nas gsum ste dgu rgyang ring du bus/ spyi bo'i snying gar bla ma bsgoms nas gsol ba btab/

lus sems lhod cing lhod pa'i ngang nas/ rnam rtog gang shar de ka la bltas nas de rang gi thog tu lhod kyis glod/ yang shar ba de'i thog tu sngar ltar slod/ yal nas stong par song ba des dga' brod mi bya/ rnam rtog mang por song ba la skyon du mi blta/ bsgom yong du re ba dang*/ ma byung gi dogs pa gnyis ka mi bya/ gang shar gyi steng du lhod de 'jog /glod drag pa rnam rtog med pa'i mi rtog pa 'dra mo 'gyu dran gang yang med pa zhig 'ong bas/ de dran pas hril gyis bsgrims te ngo shes pa ma byas na/ rang gis mi tshor la rtog pa 'og 'gyu phub ma'i 'og gi chu dong lta bu gcig yong*/ des 'phral du mi gnod pa ltar la phugs su kho rgyas nas bsgom yong du mi ster bas bsgrim dgos/ rtog pa kha 'gyu ni ngos zin pa'i 'gyu dran gtso bo yin pas de'i thog tu glod nas 'jog /je zhig nas rnam rtog mang du song bas rang tshig pa za/ nga la bsgom mi 'ong ba 'dug snyam du 'ong ste skyon med/ nyams dang po ri gzar gyi chu lta bu bya ba de de yin/ bka' brgyud pa rtse gcig rtog pa'i rba la g.yeng zer te rtse gcig chung ngu'i skabs yin/ de ka la bsran skyed de mthud pas skabs re 'dug /skabs re mi gnas pas na bye'u tsi ti mu chu la res 'dzul res thon/ skabs re rdo steng du bag re sdod pa dang 'dra/ nyams (293)gnyis pa'i skye lugs yin/ yang mu mthud pas re zhig na skabs re 'phro/ shas cher gnas pa 'dra zhig 'ong*/ dpe rgan po dang 'dra ste gnas pa shas che/ nyams gsum pa'i skye tshul yin/ yang rgyun mthud pa'i ra zhig na sbubs nang ngam yur ba'i chu ltar 'gro ba mi mngon par 'ong*/ 'di dus kyang dran pa cung zad bsgrim dgos/ nyams bzhi pa'i skye lugs yin/ de'i rgyun mthud pas/ je zhig na nyid sems gang du'ang mi 'phro bar nyin mtshan kun tu gnas pa zas skom dang gos kyi sred pa yang mi 'byung zhing*/

g.yo 'gul med par zhag dang zla ba sprel bar gnas pas dpe ri bo lta bu ste/ 'di nyes nas kha thal na nyan thos 'gog par 'gro/ legs na lus shin tu sbyangs pa thob nas zhi gnas phul du phyin pa yin/ nyams lnga pa'i skye lugs yin no// 'di dag kyang phal che ba'i dbang du byas kyis/ gang zag so so'i rtsa khams dang dbang po'i rim pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa yang srid do// de tsho dbang po tha ma'i rab la rim pas yod mod kyi 'bring tha gnyis la gnas pa skye dka' ba'i/ lus gnad sngar ltar la mdun du smin mtshams kyi thad/ 'dom gang tsam gyi sar shing bu gcig btsugs la/ de la yid mig rlung gsum dril la gtad de/ sems mi 'phro ba'i rten tsam du byas la/ bsgrim drags na sun skyen/ lhod drags na sgom 'chor bas thun chung la grangs mang ba bya/ de nas rim pas thun che la grangs nyung du btang*/ sems gnas su song ba dang shing bu de'i rtse mor a dkar po gcig bsam la sngar bzhin bsgom/ de nas thig le dkar po dang ser po la sogs pa rim pas spo zhing dmigs rten re la zhag gcig gam gsum la sogs pa ma sun par byas la ci rigs su bsgom/ shing bu'i mal na rde'u gcig bzhag la sngar ltar rim pas bsgom/ de nas rang gi lus kyi gnas (294)gsum dang*/ nang gi mgrin pa dang*/ snying kha la sogs pa yig 'bru dang thig le sogs gang red la dmigs rten bcas te bsgom pas/ rim gyis gnas pa brtan par 'gyur ro// hril dril bas rim pas goms su 'jug rgyu yin pas/ dpon slob gnyis kas ngang bsring nas/ dal bus slob cing ma sun par byed pa gnad che'o// zhi gnas kyi skabs 'dir/ sdug btsir du ma song bar sngar gyi 'jog lugs la ma yengs pa ral skor mkhan g.yul du zhugs pa lta bu bya/ zhes pa ni/ rgyal po'i mda' mkhan dang ral skor mkhan gnyis kyi bar du dngos po spungs nas da ste nyi ma gsum gyi bar du ral skor gyis la mda' rgyob cig

/mda' phog na dngos po 'di rnams mda' mkhan khyer/ ma phog na ral skor mkhan khyer cig byas pas nyi ma dang po la mda' 'phangs tshad ral skor mkhan gyi ral gri la phog nas khyer song*/ mda' mkhan gyi chung mas mda' phog gam byas pas/ mda' 'phangs tshad ral gris blangs nas ma phog zer/ mo na re/ thabs yod kyis sang mda' 'phangs shig zer nas sang nyin mos khrus byas/ rgyan gdags te/ khong gnyis kyi thad nas phar 'gro tshur 'gro mang po byas pas ral skor mkhan mo la mig yengs nas mda' phog ste/ der ral skor mkhan na re/ mda' yis ma len yengs pas len// phyin chad ral skor mkhan po kun// skad cig tsam yang ma yengs shig /yengs na nga bzhin srog dang 'bral/ zer nas shi'o// dpe de bzhin ma yengs pa rang gal che'o// da ni lhag mthong bstan te/ lhag mthong ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de yin pas/ 'di med nas lam mi bgrod pa ni/ shes rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga 'dis// dmigs bu med pas byang chub rig par nus ma yin/ zhes gsungs la/ rje btsun mi la la/ rje sgam po pas bdag gis mnyam gzhag gis zhag bdun thub pa byung*/ de la (295)bka' gdams pa kun sgom bzang po byed kyin gda' zhus pas/ ha ha zhes bzhad mo chen po mdzad de/ de sgom yin na dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi po'i lha tsho'i de yang yin te/ des ma btub/ khyod dang nga 'phrad pas 'chog ma 'phrad na lha ru skye ba yin gsungs/ mgur gzhan du// ma gi shed yi dwags bse rag pa// tshe sngon sbyin pa ma btang bas// zhim mngar gyi zas la dgra ru blta// snyoms 'jug dran med bsgom du 'dod/ zhes dgag byar mdzad do// lhag mthong de la yang gsum ste/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i lhag mthong zhes pa ni mdo sngags thams cad kyi dgongs don gang yin pa'i lhag mthong phyin ci ma log pa shes pa la zer/ sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i gnas lugs ji lta bar shes pa'i lhag mthong zhes pa da lta rang re tshos bstan nas bsgom pa 'di yin// 'di goms pas sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par mngon du gyur pa'i lhag mthong*/

'bras bu sangs rgyas thob pa'i dus der 'byung ba yin par gda'/ da zhi gnas kyi skabs ltar rnam rtog mnyam gzhag tu 'dug kyang*/ de ngo shes tsam la bzhag pas chog /rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'gyu na yang de ngo shes tsam gyi ngang du 'jog /mdor na gang shar gang byung ngo shes tsam gyi ngang la 'jog pa 'di ka yin/ bsgom nas bsgom rgyu ci yang med do// sems phyogs kyi lung rab gsal las kyang*// 'di bral rnal 'byor spun pa po// ji ltar 'bad rtsol brtson byas kyang*// 'khor ba'i 'bras bu nyid 'gyur te// rang gshis gnas su ma phyin pas// rtsol bas thang chad sdug bsngal la// bde chen snying po srog dang bral// de las nges par skyobs pa'i thabs// grangs dang rtsol ba'i srung thabs min// dri thom ngang du gso ma shor// yin don rtogs so ma 'das tsam// 'khrul snang 'dzin pa bzlog spang min// mi mthun pa nyid gnyen por rdzogs/ zhes pas/ ting (296)nge 'dzin gyi mi mthun phyogs ni rnam rtog yin/ de spangs mi dgos pa kho re'i thog tu kho rang bzhag pas rang dag la 'gro ba yin no// dbang po tha ma'i tha mas de ltar byas kyang sems las su ma rung na rnam rtog gang skyes de ngos bzung nas de ji ltar 'dug dang ga ru 'gro ba bltas pas rang dag la 'gro zhing*/ de'i rgyun bskyangs pas phyis ched du rtsad gcod mi dgos par rnam rtog kho ras kho rang grol bar byed de rang byung gi ye shes zhes bya'o// 'gyu ba'i rtsa brdar bcad na dran thog dbyings su yal/ zhes pa'i don to// spyir na tha mal gyi shes pa zhes bya ba rnam rtog gang shar gyi ngo bo la bzo bcos mi byed pa 'di la ma yengs na de gcig pos chog ste/ dbang po tha mas de ltar mi yong bas rtsol bcas kyi mnyam gzhag skyong ba yin/ rnam rtog gang shar la bltas kyang zhi ma nus par 'phro drags na lus gnad bshig 'phro mkhan kho 'phro ru rang bcug nas kho'i ngang de la bltas pas zhi mal gyis 'gro/

'phro ba dang gnas pa gnyis ka sems yin pas rang mal du gcig tu 'gyur te/ bsgom bsran bskyed pas gding tshugs par 'gyur ro// de yang*/ ji ltar gzing nas 'phur ba'i bya rog bzhin// bskor zhing bskor zhing slar yang de ru 'bab/ zhes pa'i dpe yis ston pas/ rgya mtsho'i gzing gi bya rog de ri dang chu srin brtag pa'i phyir du gso dgos la/ de 'dzam bu'i gling dang thag nye sar rkang par lcags thag phra mos ma btags na bros 'gro zhing*/ rgya mtsho'i dbus su slebs pa na gang yang mi dgos te/ yar 'phur bas ni gnam las ma 'das// phar tshur la ni bar snang las ma 'das/ mar la ni chu las ma 'das pas yas mar phyogs mtshams gang la 'phur kyang 'gro sa dang sleb sa ma rnyed pas/ gzing la sngar shul du 'bab pa bzhin du/ rnam rtog kho rang 'phro rung stong pa/ mi 'phro rung stong pa/ gnas rung 'gyu rung stong pa las ma 'das pas/ kho rang (297)gang zag de ka'i ngang du babs pas dbang po tha mas kyang rab kyi sor 'jog tu 'gyur bas nan tan ltar zab pas na 'di la bslab na legs so// de ltar dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum dgu phrugs su phye nas nyams su len tshul bstan pa ste/ slob dpon rdo rje bzhad pas mdzad pa'i rdzogs chen snyan brgyud thugs kyi nying khu las/ rab dbang po lta thog nas sgom nus/ 'bring sgom thog nas sgom nus pa// tha ma spyod thog nas sgrub nus pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o// 'di dag gi lung rgyab dgos na/ rgyud kun byed rgyal po/ sems sde bco brgyad dang*/ bdag gis byas pa'i khrid rgyab che chung gnyis bshad/ sgom la snying rus byed du bcug ste/ chos zab kyang nyams len ma bsgoms na gdams ngag zab mo dpe cha'i logs la lus zer ba de yin mod// da res sgom rgyud la thebs kyang dus rgyun du ma bsgoms na blo dred chos dred nyams len dred nas 'chi dus su mi phan pas gzab dgos/

rgyal ba rgod tshang sras phyi mtshams ri khrod du sdod tshugs pa/ nang mtshams spyil por sdod tshugs pa/ gsang mtshams mal du sdod tshugs pa/ gnyis med lta ba'i steng du sdod tshugs pa/ yengs med sgom pa'i steng du sdod tshugs pa/ chags med spyod pa'i steng du sdod tshugs pa dang drug tshang dgos gsungs/ spyir sgom la phar 'jus dang tshur 'jus gnyis yin/ sems las su ma rung ba la phar 'jug byed dgos pas dran pa dang mi bral/ de nas rnam rtog kho rang gi tshur 'jus gang shar thams cad sgom du 'gro ba yin/ de yang tha mal gyi shes pa kho ras kho rang la 'dzin pa med pa'i ngang la 'gro ba yin no// sgom chen pas bsgom btang yang*/ sgom gyis sgom chen pa mi gtong ba'i dus zer/ de yod ba la bar ma chad du bsgom dgos/ ma bsgom na da lta nyams myong phran bu skyes kyang yal 'gro bas sgom (298)'ja' tshon ma bya ba yin/ lcags kyu ma bya ba dran pas zin dus yod la/ ma zin na med pa yin/ de la ma yengs pa'i bya ra bsgrim dgos/ ya bral ma bya bar dran pa yod la snying rje dang ma 'brel ba yin/ de la thun mgor sems can gyi don du bsgom mo snyam par bya/ thun mthar dge ba sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig par bsngo/ o rgyan chen po nas// snying rje med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul// zhes gsungs pas gal shin tu che/ bdag med ma bya ba bsgom skyes nas ma bskyangs bar bor ba la zer/ blo nang du bkug nas bsgom du bcug /res 'jog ma bya ba res bsgom yong*/ res mi yong ba yin/ de la byung ma byung khyad med pa'i thog tu 'jog cing nyams su blang*/ 'khor yug ma bya ba nyin mo'i dran pa mtshan mo yang yong ba de yin/ 'di sgom gyis tshur 'jug pa'i dus de yin/ rnal 'byor mchog ces pa rdzogs pa chen po bya rtsol dang bral ba'i dus zhes bya ba de yin/ phyag rgya chen po sgom med zer ba yin no// yang gang zag rigs chad ces pa khregs chod dang thod rgal gyi snod du ma gyur pa dag kyang yod pas/

de 'dra'i rigs la dbang bskur rtsa rlung sbyangs nas las kyi phyag rgya gtad/ dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi dga' bzhi'i 'bros 'ded kyis bde ba'i ngo bo stong par ngo sprad de gong bzhin sems khrid la 'jug par gsungs la/ de ltar mi nus pa dag ni btags grol mthong grol dang myang grol la sogs pa'i thabs kyis rim gyis grol bar 'gyur ba'i tshul la 'jug par bya'o// spyir sems phyogs dang phyag rgya chen po ni/ ye shes spyir gsal zhes bya ste// brtan pa ma thob bar du yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i lta ba zhes bshad/ 'on kyang rdzogs chen de ngo sprod nas bsgom na phyi snang ba'i yul dang*/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems kyi 'phro gnas thams cad ye shes su 'char bas/ rdzogs chen rang snang ris med kyi (299)dgongs pa zer te g.yer po cher byed/ gang ltar yang rung ste/ sems ngo 'phrod phyin chad nas nang gi thog tu nyams len skyong ba las/ thod rgal la zhugs te mun khrid dam/ snang khrid byas nas 'od gsal stong gzugs kyi gtu nyams len bskyang na rang byung gi ye shes mngon sum du 'gyur te/ chos nyid kyi bar dol grol ba thob pa la the tshom med do// 'dir smras pa/ bdag lta bu sgom pa'i nyams myong ni med/ phyag rdzogs kyi chos mang po thob kyang brjed/ gong 'og gi tshig rigs rnams kyang myog se ba zhig las ma byung bas na/ rje 'ba' ra bas/ sgom pa'i nyams myong med pa'i// yig nag dpe che'i steng nas// sgom khrid 'debs blo byas kyang*// lam log gol sar bsgyur ro// zhes gsungs pas sngon chad yi ger 'god ma nus/ 'on kyang sngar gyi lung de'i 'phro las// sa thob yon tan med kyang*// bzod thob las bzhi 'grub cing*// snying rje'i rtsa ba brtan nas// gzhan don byas pas chog go /zhes gsungs/ bzod pa ma thob kyang rgyud la snying rje cung zad cig mchis pa dang*/ khyad par du sems dang chos su 'dres shing*/

ting 'dzin las su rung ba dang*/ rig pa klong nas shar ba/ sku lus mi ru 'dug kyang*/ thugs sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung rgyun cung zad dran pa rnams yi ger bkod de rig pa klong du gyur pas 'khor 'das rang sar grol ba rdzogs chen rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje rin po che phyag rdor ba'i bka' nan ches pas phul ba lags/ gang gis brten na lo zla zhag tsam gyis// sangs rgyas zhing du nges par bgrod nus pa'i// theg mchog rtse mo rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid// ji bzhin bkod pas 'gro rnams grol bar smon// 'on kyang nongs na bla ma lha la bshags// rgya bod paṇa grub bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ (300)/'di phyi bar do gsum du grol byed pa'i// zhig po bdud rtsi'i lugs bzang 'di bkod pas// 'gro kun rnam dag lam du 'jug par shog maṅga laṃ/ ༈ yang slob dpon chen po shri siṃ has// dang po thug sar gtugs/ bar du bzhag sar zhog /tha ma 'gro sar thong*/ zhes snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig

sog zlog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rkang gsum gsungs pa las/ dang por thug sar gtugs pa ni/ khrid ston shes pa'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gcig la gtugs nas/ sems kyi byung gnas 'gro gsum rtsad brdar bcad de zhu gtugs byed pa'o// bar du gzhog sar bzhag pa ni/ gang shar la bzo bcos med par 'jog pa'o// tha ma 'gro sar gtong ba ni/ nyams myong ting nge 'dzin gyi rol zhen pa med par 'dzin med du gtong ba'o// snyan brgyud tshig gsum bka' 'grel// i th-i/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
